title: Profound Turmoil in the Ruins
next_chapter_hook: The core area of the ruins suddenly trembled violently, an existence transcending the Heavenly Dao was awakening

text.content: The strange glint that flickered in Chen Ling's eyes was like a slender needle, piercing the softest corner of Chen Ji's heart. He suppressed the churning unease, his fingertips gently brushing across the weathered inscriptions on the stone walls, continuing deeper into the ruins. Each step was treading upon the dust of years, yet seemed to be stepping upon the chessboard of destiny. In the depths of the dark corridor, dense characters began appearing on the walls, their style ancient and bold, radiating a heart-wrenching desolation. Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted — those were Chen Family characters, farewell words left by generations of prophets of the Chen Family

The walls were covered with densely packed names, each name accompanied by a brief farewell inscription. Chen Ji's fingers gently brushed those cold stone carvings, as if caressing a genealogy written with blood and tears. 'Chen Xuan, sacrifice failed, soul scattered.' 'Chen Tianming, glimpsed Heavenly Secrets, died within three days.' 'Chen Lunhui, whoever sees the Heavenly Secrets shall die, none can escape.' Line after line of startling farewell words recorded the tragic fates of the Chen Family's generations of prophets. Behind each name was a soul devoured by the Tianji Record

dialogue.content: 'Do you see?' Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, cold as water from the Nine Nether Springs, 'These are all your ancestors. Each once received the recognition of the Tianji Record, yet not one met a good end. The Tianji Record drained their Heavenly Fate, divined the Heavenly Secrets, and ultimately devoured them one by one. This is the destiny of the Chen Family prophets' bloodline — from the moment of obtaining the Tianji Record, they were already sentenced to death'

text.content: Chen Ji's heartbeat suddenly accelerated. He pressed forward, and in an empty stone chamber, the inscriptions on the walls suddenly became different — those characters were no longer cold farewell words, but passages full of warmth. What shocked him most was that the style of those inscriptions was all too familiar. It was his mother Chen Nian's handwriting, the penmanship he had seen since childhood. 'What the heart remembers, the echo will answer. Ji'er, if you see these words, it means you have arrived here'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's body stiffened violently. Mother? How could there be his mother's handwriting here? He clearly remembered that his mother 'died of illness' after giving birth to him, and his father told him that his mother was merely an ordinary mortal woman who never practiced any cultivation technique. But these inscriptions were clearly his mother's penmanship! His breathing grew rapid, his hands trembling slightly, and an ominous premonition enveloped his entire being. His mother's death was undoubtedly hiding an enormous secret

'You've finally discovered it.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a sigh, as if he had long foreseen this moment, 'Your mother Chen Nian was no ordinary person. In the sacrifice ten thousand years ago, she was the protagonist — the only 'half sacrifice' to survive the offering. She used some forbidden method to split herself in two, one half remaining in the mortal world to give birth to you, while the other was sealed in the deepest part of these ruins. The so-called 'feigned death' was nothing but a deception to fool heaven'

text.content: Chen Ji felt his mind go blank. Ten-thousand-year sacrifice? Half sacrifice? His mother's death was actually an elaborately designed deception? His legs softened, nearly collapsing to the ground. Mo Xiansheng's words struck his heart like heavy hammers, blow after blow. He had always believed his mother was just a pitiful mortal woman, never expecting her to be a survivor of that catastrophe ten thousand years ago. He drew a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm, and continued forward. He needed to know more truth

At the end of the stone chamber, Chen Ji witnessed a breathtaking scene. A massive sealing formation stood in the center of the stone chamber, and at the formation's core position, a crystal-clear jade slip floated. On the jade slip, Chen Xuan's name was clearly inscribed. And at the edge of the sealing formation, Chen Ji saw another passage of text: 'Chen Xuan, the last generation prophet of the Chen Family ten thousand years ago. He discovered the truth of the sacrifice, wishing to break the control of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but was ultimately erased. These ruins are his final gift to you'

dialogue.content: 'Chen Xuan is me.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor for the first time, 'I was once the most talented prophet in this world. I discovered the truth of the Tianji Record — it is not some divine artifact, but a tool for the Heavenly Dao's Eye to drain Heavenly Fate. Every generation of prophets was its food. I refused to accept this, I wanted to resist, to destroy all of this. So I established these ruins, sealed myself here, waiting for a destined person'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. So that was it! Chen Xuan establishing these ruins was not to complete the sacrifice, but to destroy the Tianji Record! He wanted to destroy the tool of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, to break the cursed fate passed down through generations in the Chen Family! But the power of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was too overwhelming. In the end, Chen Xuan was still erased. His plan failed at the last moment, leaving only these ruins and this jade slip, waiting for a later successor to complete his unfinished cause

Chen Ji walked before the sealing formation, reached out, and took down that jade slip. The jade slip was warm and smooth to the touch, emanating a faint glow. He probed his divine sense into the jade slip, and a passage of text clearly appeared in his mind: 'Ji'er, if you can see these words, it means you have arrived here. Destroy the Tianji Record, do not complete it! Once the Tianji Record is complete, the Heavenly Dao's Eye will fully awaken, and then the entire world will fall into eternal darkness. Mother has done her best. The road ahead, you must walk yourself'

Chen Ji's hand shook violently. Destroy the Tianji Record? This was his mother's dying wish! But if he destroyed the Tianji Record, his Heavenly Fate would be completely exhausted, and he would lose all ability to foresee the future. Moreover, the Tianji Record Fragment was still within him — how could destroying it be so easy? What made him even more conflicted was: what if he completed the sacrifice instead? His strength would soar, perhaps even touching the mysteries of the Great Dao, but in that case, the Heavenly Dao's Eye would fully awaken. He was caught in a dilemma

Just as Chen Ji was conflicted, a violent tremor suddenly came from the depths of the ruins. The tremor grew increasingly intense, as if some terrifying existence was awakening. The runes on the stone walls began flashing madly, and an oppressive aura that could suffocate people swept over from the depths of the ruins' core. Chen Ji's face changed dramatically — his Tianji Record was jumping wildly at this moment, as if warning him of something terrible. A cold voice came from the depths of the ruins: 'Descendant of the Chen Family, you have finally come'

text.content: Chen Ji tightly gripped the jade slip in his hand, drew a deep breath, and connected his divine sense with the Tianji Record Fragment. In an instant, a soul-tearing intense pain came from the depths of his Mental Sea. His mother's words echoed in his mind: 'Destroy the Tianji Record, do not complete it!' He gritted his teeth, guiding the Heavenly Fate power within his body, and charged toward the Tianji Record Fragment

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, silently calculating the pros and cons in his heart. His mother's dying wish was certainly important, but if he couldn't even survive the present crisis, what future was there to speak of? He slowly raised his hand and began to guide the power within the sealing formation. A vast energy like the sea surged from his palm, flowing toward the Tianji Record Fragment within his body.

In the instant when the two forces were about to collide, a deafening roar suddenly erupted from the depths of the ruins' core. A terrifying might that transcended heavenly comprehension flooded in like a tide, shrouding the entire ruins. Chen Ji's Tianji Record went mad with agitation at this moment, countless blurred images flickering before his eyes like a kaleidoscope. The stone walls in the ruins' core area began to collapse, a brilliant light bursting from the cracks, illuminating the entire dark space. The power contained within that light made Chen Ji feel a bone-deep chill—it was an existence that transcended the Heavenly Way, awakening.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently, an unprecedented fear surging in his heart. He had once thought he understood this world well enough, had thought the Heavenly Eye was the greatest enemy. But the existence awakening before him, its terrifying pressure far exceeded everything he had encountered before. It was not a puppet of the Heavenly Eye, but an entity equal to the Heavenly Eye! A terrifying thought flashed through Chen Ji's mind: could the Heavenly Eye not be the sole Chess Player in this game?
